mutations.content:
on damage:
    victim is a player
    attacker is set
    attacker is not a player
    spawn a creeper at location of victim
    set {_creeper} to last spawned creeper
    set target of {_creeper} to attacker
    set {vengeful::%{_creeper}%} to true

on target:
    entity is a creeper
    {vengeful::%entity%} is true
    target is a player
    cancel event

on damage of a player:
    attacker is a creeper
    {vengeful::%attacker%} is true
    cancel event

every 1 second:
    loop all entities:
        loop-entity is a creeper
        {vengeful::%loop-entity%} is true
        if target of loop-entity is not set:
            kill loop-entity
            delete {vengeful::%loop-entity%}
        else if loop-entity is in the ignition process:
            create an explosion of force 3 at location of loop-entity
            kill loop-entity
            delete {vengeful::%loop-entity%}

on death of a creeper:
    {vengeful::%event-entity%} is true
    delete {vengeful::%event-entity%}

traces.intent_summary: Create a new creeper mob that ignores players and explodes on entities that attack the player, with block damage disabled.

traces.rationale: The script uses the 'on damage' event to detect when a player is attacked by a non-player entity, spawning a custom-named creeper to retaliate. The 'on target' event prevents the creeper from targeting players, and the 'on explosion' event uses 'clear the block explosion list' to ensure no block damage occurs, adhering to vanilla Skript constraints.
